name: Lovelink
source: Love link is an interactive virtual reality romance game that allows you to navigate through your chats with your choices! With interesting, exciting, and thrilling characters to browse through Dive into an all-new narrative dating experience.
translation: Love Link是一款互动式虚拟现实浪漫游戏，可让你根据自己的选择浏览聊天内容！有趣、令人兴奋、惊心动魄的人物可供浏览，沉浸在全新的叙事约会体验中。
